# Agent Skills Setup (skills-repo)
> Offline, previewed, and rollback-safe migration of AI coding context (Skills, Rules, Instructions, and MCP) across Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Windsurf, Copilot, and Gemini CLI.

Agent Skills Setup provides cross-IDE context translation, secret-redacting backup bundles (ACB), and deterministic migration between AI developer environments.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/README.md): High-level overview, quick installation, supported IDE matrix, and FAQ.
- [Canonical Skill Descriptor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/skills/agent-skills-setup/SKILL.md): Agent-native skill specification, CLI synopsis, and prompt triggers.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated reference documentation including migration boundaries and command recipes.
